method: Contemporary timetable identifies Ruzyně; OurAirports supplies approximate modern site coordinates only. Existing Orly and Ferihegy objects are unchanged.

airports.name: Prag–Ruzyně
airports.location_note: Contemporary Air France timetable printed pages 74 and 81 explicitly identifies Ruzyně, 17 km from Prague. Modern OurAirports coordinates are an approximate marker for that airfield, not a reconstructed 1986 terminal, gate, runway or aircraft position. Czechoslovakia is the historical country; no split into modern Czech and Slovak states is made.
